# Royal Phuket City Hotel

> Official website of Royal Phuket City Hotel, a 4-star hotel in Phuket Town, Thailand, with accommodation, wedding venues, meeting and conference facilities, and dining.

This is a navigation guide to the hotel's public information. Current packages, availability, prices, venue layouts, and services are described on the linked pages or confirmed by the hotel team. Event capacity depends on the room and seating arrangement.

## Hotel and contact

- [Official homepage](https://royalphuketcity.com/): Hotel overview and direct reservation link.
- [Contact and location](https://royalphuketcity.com/contact): Hotel enquiries, directions, and contact details.
- [Rooms and suites](https://royalphuketcity.com/rooms-suites): Accommodation types and room details.
- [Facilities](https://royalphuketcity.com/facilities): Hotel facilities and services.
- [Promotions](https://royalphuketcity.com/promotions): Current offers and their terms.
- [Fact sheets](https://royalphuketcity.com/download-fact-sheets): Hotel and event information for planners.

Address: 154 Phang-Nga Road, Talad Yai, Muang, Phuket 83000, Thailand.
Telephone: +66 76 233 355.
Reservations email: reservation@royalphuketcity.com.

## Weddings in Phuket

- [Wedding venues](https://royalphuketcity.com/wedding-venues): Wedding spaces, planning services, catering, and wedding enquiries in Phuket Town.
- [Engagement ceremonies](https://royalphuketcity.com/wedding-venues/engagement-ceremony): Engagement celebration options.
- [Thai weddings](https://royalphuketcity.com/wedding-venues/thai-wedding): Thai ceremony and reception arrangements.
- [Chinese weddings](https://royalphuketcity.com/wedding-venues/chinese-wedding): Tea ceremonies and wedding banquets.
- [Muslim weddings](https://royalphuketcity.com/wedding-venues/muslim-wedding): Muslim ceremony and catering information.
- [Western weddings](https://royalphuketcity.com/wedding-venues/western-wedding): Western ceremony and reception options.
- [LGBTQ+ weddings](https://royalphuketcity.com/wedding-venues/lgbtq-wedding): Inclusive wedding celebrations.
